newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs seen steady to up, pork belly calls mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs seen steady to up, pork belly calls mixed.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.300 cent per lb higher while calls ranged from 0.500 cent higher to 0.300 lower on pork belly futures, livestock analysts said.

Carryover demand was expected in hog futures following steady to higher cash hog indications. Hog runs slowed late this week after an early-week surge of hogs that had been backed up by harsh weather. The slower marketings should support hog futures, sources said.
Also, some hogs need to put on more weight before being sold, analysts said.
The latest CME lean hog index was down $1.22 at $72.61 per cwt.
